title: Abbaa Biyyummaa Dhuma Lafaa Irra Deeme
intro: Mee bulchaa humna guddaa qabu, humnaa fi aangoo lafa irratti kennameef yaadi. Lakkoofsi kun imala adda ta’e irratti kan bobba’e yoo ta’u, bakka aduun itti lixxuu fi bakka itti baatu ga’ee, ummatoota ajaa’ibaa waliin wal arguun saboota manca’aa lama irraa qormaata guddaa isa mudate. Hogganaan dhokataan kun eenyu?
clues: Ani bulchaa aangoo fi mala golee lafaa isa fagoo gaʼuuf kenname ture.
Gara dhihaatti imaluun birraa dukkanaaʼaa taʼe tokko keessatti aduun akka lixxu argeera.
Ummanni naannoo aduu baateetti kan ho’a ishee irraa gaaddisa hin qabne tokkon qunname.
Hawaasni biraa immoo saboota malaammaltoota lama Goog fi Maagoog jedhamuun beekaman irratti gargaarsa koo gaafate.
Isaan qabachuuf sibiilaa fi sibiila diimaa baqfame fayyadamee danqaa tokkon ijaare.
Gufuun kun rahmata Gooftaa kiyya irraa akka ta’e, hanga yeroo murtaa’etti akka turu labse.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
